visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + text + field + button + link
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Newsletter subscription panel: icon, heading and intro, first name / last name / email form with Subscribe button, privacy note

contentPattern.structure: Cells: 1) icon image; 2) heading and intro text; 3) a single link whose href is the form submit URL and whose text is the button label; 4) privacy note with link. The form fields are generated by the block

reuseGuidance: Use once near the foot of a page. Without a submit link the form does not post anywhere.
